guide_enrichment.narrative:
For us, the case for Purdue staying closer than the market expects starts with its ability to generate enough offense. Ryan Browne has 15 career starts for Purdue, and he opened the season by completing 23 of 29 passes for 317 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions. We are not treating one game against Indiana State as proof, but that experience and efficiency matter when the market is asking Purdue to absorb such a wide talent gap.

The concern is that our matchup numbers strongly favor Notre Dame on the other side of the ball, particularly in rushing efficiency and scoring-opportunity creation. Purdue limited Indiana State to 66 rushing yards, but that result does not erase the longer-run defensive indicators. There is also meaningful uncertainty around a roster that had 16 players make their first Purdue starts in the opener. Our model sees enough offensive competence to create a modest disagreement with the market, but the defensive matchup keeps that difference from becoming actionable at the current price.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch:
We are watching Notre Dame's rushing offense against Purdue's run defense. Our efficiency numbers place those units near opposite ends of the national picture, and that matters because consistent rushing success would give Notre Dame repeated chances to create separation.

Purdue's opener offered some encouragement, with only 66 rushing yards allowed, but we need to view that performance in context rather than assume it carries over against Notre Dame. If Purdue's front performs better than our longer-run numbers suggest, the case for a competitive margin becomes much stronger. If not, the market's more aggressive expectation will be easier to justify.

recent_game.fact: Purdue opened the 2026 season with a 44-19 home win over Indiana State.
Purdue produced 523 total yards against Indiana State, its first 500-yard game since Oct. 12, 2024 at Illinois.
Purdue had no turnovers and won the turnover battle against Indiana State.
Sixteen players made their first starts as Boilermakers in the season opener.

opponent_notes.fact: Purdue is scheduled to host Notre Dame on Sept. 26, 2026 at Ross-Ade Stadium.
Notre Dame was ranked No. 4 and had a 1-0 record when this guide was issued.
The Purdue-Notre Dame game will be played for the Shillelagh Trophy.

quarterback.fact: Starting quarterback Ryan Browne completed 23 of 29 passes for 317 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions against Indiana State.
The Indiana State game was Browne's fourth career 300-yard passing performance.
Browne has made 15 career starts for Purdue and started all 12 games in 2025.
Browne started 2026 with a full offseason to work with Purdue's offensive line and receivers after returning following spring practice in 2025.
Evans Chuba and Bennett Meredith competed for the backup quarterback role during the spring and summer.

offensive_personnel.fact: True freshman Brock Brownfield became Purdue's first true freshman offensive lineman to start a season opener since freshmen became eligible in 1972.
Joey Tanona was the only returning offensive lineman who started all 12 games in 2025; Ethan Trent made six starts and Jude McCoskey played in 11 games.
Purdue added transfer offensive linemen Boaz Stanley, Nuku Mafi and Micah Banuelos, who entered 2026 with 21, 12 and five career starts, respectively.
Minnesota transfer Fame Ijeboi rushed 11 times for 87 yards and a touchdown and caught two passes for 30 yards in his Purdue debut.
FAU transfer Asaad Waseem caught six passes for 107 yards and one touchdown in his Purdue debut.
Xavier Townsend caught seven passes for 47 yards and returned three punts for 24 yards in his Purdue debut.
Antonio Harris is the only returning running back from 2025; he rushed for 305 yards and two touchdowns on 69 carries last season.

defensive_personnel.fact: FIU transfer Mister Clark recorded five solo tackles, two tackles for loss, one sack and one pass breakup against Indiana State.
Don Saunders returned an interception 35 yards for a touchdown against Indiana State, Purdue's first pick-six since 2022.
Linebacker Charles Correa returned after recording 96 tackles, 7.5 tackles for loss and three sacks in 12 starts during 2025.
Purdue added defensive linemen Rodney Lora, Curt Neal and Wisdom Simms, who brought a combined 81 games of college experience.
Transfer linebacker Jojo Hayden made four tackles, including one tackle for loss, in his Purdue debut.
Transfer defensive back Jaden Mangham made four solo tackles in his first Purdue game.

coaching_changes.fact: Kevin Kane returned to Purdue as defensive coordinator and linebackers coach after serving as a Minnesota defensive analyst in 2025; he previously coordinated Purdue's defense in 2023 and 2024.
Zach Crabtree became Purdue's offensive line coach after spending the 2025 season at Fresno State.
Cornell Ford moved from wide receivers coach to running backs coach for 2026.
Bilal Marshall was promoted from offensive analyst to wide receivers coach during the offseason.
Barry Odom is in his second season as Purdue's head coach.

injury_availability.fact: Tight end Kylan Fox suffered an injury at the start of training camp and will miss the 2026 season.
Tight end George Burhenn returned for 2026 after an injury at Notre Dame ended his 2025 season early.
Burhenn caught two passes for 43 yards against Indiana State in his first game action in 349 days.
Wide receivers De'Nylon Morrissette and Chauncey Magwood returned after missing the 2025 season due to injuries.
Magwood caught a six-yard touchdown against Indiana State, his first touchdown reception since 2022.

offensive_context.fact: Purdue passed for 346 yards and rushed for 177 yards against Indiana State.
Purdue converted 54.5 percent of its third downs against Indiana State.
Five different players scored Purdue's five touchdowns against Indiana State, and each touchdown was that player's first for Purdue.
Purdue possessed the ball for 37 minutes and 22 seconds against Indiana State.

defensive_context.fact: Purdue allowed Indiana State 284 total yards, including 66 rushing yards and 218 passing yards.
Purdue limited Indiana State to 12 first downs.
Purdue recorded three sacks and eight tackles for loss against Indiana State.
Indiana State converted one of three fourth-down attempts against Purdue.

special_teams.fact: True freshman kicker Jacobo Echeverria Lozano made all three field-goal attempts and all five extra-point attempts against Indiana State.
Echeverria Lozano's field goals against Indiana State came from 39, 27 and 25 yards.
Buffalo transfer Dylan Drennan had one 54-yard punt with a net of 49 yards in his Purdue debut.

series_context.fact: Purdue trails Notre Dame 61-26-2 in the all-time series.
Notre Dame has won the last 10 games in the series.
Purdue lost 56-30 to Notre Dame in 2025.

other_relevant.fact: Purdue added 32 transfers and 22 freshmen for the 2026 season; 19 of the transfers came from Power Four programs.
Purdue's 2026 captains are Ryan Browne, Charles Correa, Hudauri Hines, Jude McCoskey, De'Nylon Morrissette and Curt Neal.
